voice: ElevenLabs eleven_v4, Juanito (u1CVBnSUn9JiL8ssgd2v), Taglish, one take, split into lines, inner pauses capped at 0.45 s, atempo 1.0

lines.text: Kapag may liwanag na sumusunod sa'yo sa palayan, huwag mo itong sundan.
lines.beat_before: hook: dark rice paddies; a ball of fire above the palay keeping pace with the camera

lines.text: Santelmo ang tawag dito ng mga magsasaka.
lines.beat_before: the pilapil, a farmer and his flashlight; the light keeping pace

lines.text: Isang bola ng apoy, lumulutang sa palayan. Sa ilog. Sa dagat.
lines.beat_before: a wide: paddies under clouds, a nipa hut, the canal, the pump; the light far over the field

lines.text: May totoong liwanag na kilala ng siyensya, ang St. Elmo's fire. Kumakapit ito sa palo ng barko kapag may bagyo.
lines.beat_before: a ship in a storm, a glow clinging to its mast (St. Elmo's fire)

lines.text: Pero hindi ito sumusunod sa'yo pauwi.
lines.beat_before: back on the pilapil: he stops, it stops; he walks, it walks

lines.text: Sabi ng matatanda, kaluluwa raw ang santelmo. Isang nalunod, na hindi na natagpuan.
lines.beat_before: it drifts over the canal; its reflection, and a second glow under the water
the frogs stop; it splits into three
silence; it comes close at face height; inside the fire, four frames of a drowned face (stinger in silence)

lines.text: Baligtarin mo ang damit mo, sabi nila. Nawawala ka sa paningin nito.
lines.beat_before: he turns his shirt inside out; the light shrinks, drifts back and sinks into the canal
dawn: a scorched circle in the palay; far off, a fourth light
